title: Notice requirements.
bodyText: Each licensed retail outlet shall post adequate notice that clearly cautions each person purchasing consumer fireworks of the prohibitions, liabilities, and penalties incorporated in sections 132D-12, 132D-13, 132D-14, and 132D-5.5.
bodyHtml: §132D-15  Notice requirements.  Each licensed retail outlet shall post adequate notice that clearly cautions each person purchasing consumer fireworks of the prohibitions, liabilities, and penalties incorporated in sections 132D-12, 132D-13, 132D-14, and 132D-5.5. [L 1994, c 180, pt of §1; am L 2025, c 243, §14]
